_comment: A service account that can read secrets and objects — but Data Access audit logging is OFF (the GCP default). Reads of secrets/objects are therefore never written to the log, so no rule can ever see them. This is a blind spot that comes from LOGGING, independent of any detection rule.
_expect: blindspots secretmanager.versions.access  ->  GAP, reason = unlogged: reachable, but AccessSecretVersion is a Data Access method and data-access logging is off, so it is never recorded.
blindspots storage.objects.get  ->  same story: reachable but unlogged.
Compare with 04_data_access_on.json, which is identical except logging is enabled.
name: data-access-off
